assertions.name: no_i10_violations
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = no script has both legacy + canonical called)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, no script keeps a legacy formula reachable alongside its canonical counterpart.

description: I10 audit (heuristic) per local/compute-integration-watcher: scripts where a `<name>_legacy` / `_old` / `_v1` / `_v0` / `_pre_canonical` / `_deprecated` / `_orig` / `_original` / `_first` function coexists with a canonical sibling (`<name>`), AND both are still CALLED in the script body.  Strategy 2 also flags banner-marked defs (`# LEGACY`, `# DEPRECATED`, `# OBSOLETE`, `# SUPERSEDED`, `# OLD` above a `def`).  Per-script evidence in `rows[]` lets reviewers triage real I10 violations from intentional A/B cross-validation scripts.
